# `Q-19-5` — Invalid Lightbox Option

> A `lightbox` option has a value Quarto does not recognize, so the
> default is used instead.

## What this means

The [`lightbox`](../../guides/formats/html/lightbox.qmd) option, or one
of its sub-options, was given a value Quarto cannot use. That one value is
ignored and its default applies; the rest of the lightbox configuration
still takes effect, and the page still renders.

## Why this happens

- **An unknown value**, such as `effect: wobble`. `effect` takes `fade`,
  `zoom` or `none`; `desc-position` takes `top`, `bottom`, `left` or
  `right`; `match` takes `auto`; `loop` takes `true` or `false`.
- **An unknown option name** under `lightbox:`, often a typo.
- **A `lightbox` value that is not `true`, `false`, `auto` or a map.**
- **A code cell's `lightbox` option** that could not be read, or that
  lists fewer values than the cell makes plots.

## How to fix

Use one of the values listed above, or remove the option to get the
default. Quarto 1 stopped the render on an unknown `effect`; Quarto 2
warns and carries on.
